pictures.name: DN1-Lahore-Mansion
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Old Lahore at golden hour: a grand many-storied mansion of carved sandstone and wooden balconies, with a row of tall silk flags flying from its roof against a deep blue sky. On the main balcony stands Duni Chand, a proud wealthy merchant of about fifty with a grey-streaked beard, a gold-embroidered cream silk robe, a saffron turban and heavy gold rings, gazing at his flags. Busy street below.

pictures.name: DN3-The-Needle
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A close, quiet view: a hand in a plain saffron-brown sleeve places one small, simple steel sewing needle into the open palm of a hand heavy with gold rings and a gold-embroidered cream silk cuff. The needle catches a single point of light. Soft background of rich carpets and lamplight, deep blue shadows. Intimate and symbolic.

pictures.name: DN4-Wife-Asks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. An inner room of the mansion at night, lit by a clay oil lamp. Duni Chand’s wife, a gentle, wise woman of about forty-five in a deep blue shawl edged with gold, holds the small needle up between her fingers toward the lamplight and looks at her husband with a calm, searching question. Duni Chand, the merchant with the grey-streaked beard, cream silk robe and saffron turban, sits stunned. Quiet, thoughtful.

pictures.name: DN5-Sharing
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Morning at the mansion’s open gate. Duni Chand, the merchant with the grey-streaked beard, now in a plain cream robe and saffron turban with no rings, hands sacks of grain and warm bread with his own hands to poor families, elders and laborers. His wife in her deep blue shawl helps beside him. Soft gold light, kindness.

pictures.name: DN6-Today-Portion
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A warm modern home kitchen at evening. A young Sikh woman in a soft sweater with her hair tied back, a steel kara on her wrist, divides a big pot of fresh homemade curry and rice into containers, and sets the first one aside, wrapped in a cloth, near the front door for a neighbor. Gold lamplight, steam, blue evening at the window, quiet generosity.
